scientific_limits: Matching-linear realized tests are primarily implementation and numerical controls. Under its assumed prior/likelihood, the expected-utility action is Bayes-risk optimal by construction; model-consistent gains alone do not validate physical inference or practical superiority.
Current categorical fixture layouts and two material/support scalars are a restricted controlled problem, not a generalized3D boundary-condition neural model.
Fresh independent physical-model or experimental observations, complete paired baselines and uncertainty checks are needed before calibrated prediction or scientific active-probing advantage claims.
